title: The plan check fails a hide the Joomla receiver cannot take off (R27)
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The ported hide review lists the same slots, tier by tier, as the plugin's review for JA Diner 1.0.8 and JA Boxing 1.0.10.
A hidden article title or intro picture fails R27; a hidden sentence of an HTML field passes, as the rows door takes it.
A picture the receiver takes only with its row fails when hidden alone and passes once another slot of the row is hidden.

tests: the port lists what the plugin's review lists: JA Diner 1.0.8 and JA Boxing 1.0.10, tier by tier
an article's title hidden is refused; a sentence of its HTML text goes by the door; a kit with no review skips
a picture the receiver never empties (an article's intro image) cannot be hidden
a picture the receiver takes only with its row fails alone and passes once another slot of the row goes too
